image-pipeline.method: NgOptimizedImage (ngSrc, sizes, priority) with the built-in provideCloudinaryLoader (Cloudinary public demo cloud does the resizing/format)
image-pipeline.evidence: srcset="https://res.cloudinary.com/demo/image/upload/f_auto,q_auto,w_16,h_11/sample.jpg 16w, https://res.cloudinary.com/demo/image/upload/f_auto,q_auto,w_32,h_21/sample…" (16 widths), width/height=800x533, offscreen loading=lazy (loaded before scroll=false), SSR preload link=true, https://res.cloudinary.com/demo/image/upload/f_auto,q_auto,w_640,h_426/sample.jpg -> 200 image/avif; resizing/format done by Cloudinary, not Angular

caching.method: RenderMode.Prerender + default HttpClient transfer cache (provideClientHydration) + per-route ServerRoute headers (Cache-Control s-maxage)
caching.evidence: prerendered stamp 1795670381998 == 1795670381998 across requests (live API counter 1->2); hydration made 0 /api/ft/now requests (ng-state transfer cache), shown=1795670381998; server route Cache-Control="public, max-age=0, s-maxage=60, stale-while-revalidate=300" but its stamp changes per request locally (1795670391595 vs 1795670391622): no server/data cache or ISR, reuse only via a CDN honoring s-maxage

route-prefetching.method: provideRouter(..., withPreloading(FlaggedPreloading)) (a PreloadingStrategy that preloads routes with data.preload) for lazy routes + @defer (on interaction; prefetch on hover)
route-prefetching.evidence: withPreloading(FlaggedPreloading) fetched target route chunk chunk-DpSJSo2s.js on page load before any click/hover (eager, not hover/viewport-driven); @defer prefetch on hover fetched its chunk on hover (not before); link click fetched 0 JS files

islands.method: Incremental hydration: @defer (hydrate never) static card + @defer (hydrate on interaction) counter island, default-on with provideClientHydration()

reactivity.method: signal() read in an OnPush child template (zoneless default); render counters on parent and child templates + constructors
reactivity.evidence: count 0->3; constructors parent 1->1, child 1->1; 3 signal.set() calls from outside Angular: parent template runs 1->1, child (signal-reading) template runs 1->4; 1 (click) handler: parent 1->2, child 4->5. Granularity is the component view (its whole template update pass re-runs), not the text node; assertion: Error: signal-reading component template re-ran expect(received).toBe(expected) // Object.is equality Expected: 1 Received: 4

third-party-scripts.method: Hand-rolled: afterNextRender + requestIdleCallback injects an async <script src=/ft/third-party.js>

multi-host-deployment.method: Hand-written SSR entries per host (server.ts Express/AngularNodeAppEngine, server.cloudflare.ts + server.netlify.ts AngularAppEngine) chosen by angular.json configurations
multi-host-deployment.evidence: node -> dist-ft/node/{browser,server/server.mjs} (1137 KB); cloudflare -> dist-ft/cloudflare/{browser,server/server.mjs} (247 KB); netlify -> dist-ft/netlify/{browser,server/server.mjs} (248 KB); Vercel reuses the node build via api/index.js; each host needs a hand-written SSR entry
